backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.intro: Save your whole vault to one encrypted file, or rebuild it from a file you saved earlier. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
backup.exportBody: Writes every document, reminder and attachment to a single .evault file, encrypted with a passphrase you choose.
backup.restoreBody: Opens a .evault file and replaces everything currently in your vault with its contents.
backup.passwordExplainer: At least {{length}} characters. This passphrase is the only thing protecting the file once it leaves this device.
backup.passwordWarning: There is no way to recover this passphrase. If you lose it, the backup cannot be opened by anyone, including us.
backup.passwordSingleCharacter: Use more than one repeated character.
backup.passwordMismatch: The two passphrases do not match.
backup.previewMigrated: This backup was made by an older version and has been upgraded to open here.
backup.restoreWarningBody: Everything currently in ExpiryVault on this device will be deleted and replaced by the contents of this file. This cannot be undone.
backup.restoreConfirmHint: Deletes the current vault and restores the backup
backup.exportedOrphans_one: {{count}} file with no matching record was left out and will be cleared on the next restore.
backup.exportedOrphans_other: {{count}} files with no matching record were left out and will be cleared on the next restore.
backup.restoredBody_one: {{count}} document is back in your vault.
backup.restoredBody_other: {{count}} documents are back in your vault.
backup.restoredMissing_one: {{count}} attachment file could not be written.
backup.restoredMissing_other: {{count}} attachment files could not be written.
backup.errorNotABackup: That file is not an ExpiryVault backup.
backup.errorNewerVersion: This backup was made by a newer version of ExpiryVault. Update the app and try again.
backup.errorWrongPassword: That passphrase did not open the file. Check it and try again.
backup.errorCorrupt: The passphrase was right but the file is damaged, so it cannot be restored. Your vault has not been changed.
backup.errorInvalidPayload: The file opened but its contents are not a vault this version can read. Your vault has not been changed.
backup.errorIo: The file could not be read or written. Your vault has not been changed.
backup.safetyBody: The backup is encrypted, so a copy in a cloud drive or on a memory card is readable only with your passphrase. Without it, the file cannot be opened by anyone.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: ExpiryVault stores everything on this device. There are no accounts, no servers and no analytics.
privacy.dataBody: The documents you add — their names, numbers, issuers, dates and any images you attach — are stored in an encrypted database on this phone.
privacy.encryptionBody: The database is encrypted with SQLCipher (AES-256-CBC with HMAC-SHA512). The key is held in the device keychain and never leaves it. Attached images are stored in app-private storage and are not separately encrypted.
privacy.networkBody: Nothing. ExpiryVault makes no network requests. Text recognition runs entirely on this device.
privacy.notificationsBody: Reminders are scheduled locally by your device. Their text can include a document's name, so it may appear on your lock screen.
privacy.deletionBody: Deleting a document removes it and its images immediately. Uninstalling the app removes everything.
